description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across different language families. The categories, representing language families—including IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque—are displayed on the vertical axis, listed in an unspecified order. The horizontal axis, labeled “# tasks”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each language family is represented by a single, solid-colored bar. The bars vary in length, with the IE-Slavic family having the longest bar, extending to approximately 74 tasks, while the Basque family has the shortest, extending to approximately 1 task. The bars are colored as follows: IE-Slavic is light blue, IE-Romance is medium blue, IE-Germanic is light green, Uralic is green, IE-Baltic is light orange, IE-other is red, IE-Indic is orange, Semitic is dark orange, Turkic is yellow, and Basque is light yellow. No bars are visually emphasized, and there is no apparent grouping or stacking of bars.
